title: MTandT Rentals Limited Secures INR 100 Crore Investment from ValueQuest
cardTitle: MTandT Rentals Limited Secures INR 100 Crore Investment from ValueQuest
body:
Strengthening India's Equipment Rental Sector

MTandT Rentals provides comprehensive solutions for infrastructure, industrial, and construction sectors through its portfolio of aerial work platforms—including boom lifts, scissor lifts, and spider lifts—and ground protection access solutions such as PortaDeck composite mats. The company complements its rental offerings with equipment maintenance, operator training, and technical support services.

The investment will enable MRL to expand its equipment fleet and enhance service capabilities, strengthening the company's capacity to serve large-scale infrastructure and industrial projects while driving broader adoption of specialized equipment rental solutions across India.

Mr. Rakesh Modi, Chairman, MTandT Rentals, said: "This partnership with ValueQuest marks a significant milestone in our growth journey. The investment will empower us to scale operations, enhance our service portfolio, and reinforce our commitment to safety and operational excellence. We extend our gratitude to Systematix Corporate Services Limited and Invicta Capserv Private Limited for their invaluable guidance throughout this transaction."

ValueQuest's investment reflects confidence in MRL's market position and growth potential. The company has demonstrated a strong growth trajectory with a CAGR of over 48% during FY21–FY25, establishing itself as a trusted partner for safety and reliability in India's equipment rental industry.

Systematix Corporate Services Limited and Invicta Capserv Private Limited jointly advised MTandT Rentals on this transaction.

title: Vertikal Partners with Comansa for Exclusive Tower Crane Sales & Rental
cardTitle: Vertikal Partners with Comansa for Exclusive Tower Crane Sales & Rental
body:
Vertikal Signs Exclusive Sales and Rental Partnership Agreement with Comansa for India, Nepal, and Bhutan

Pamplona, Spain – 16 Oct 2024 – Mtandt Group, through its entity Vertikal, is pleased to announce that it has signed an exclusive sales and rental partnership agreement with Comansa, a global leader in tower crane manufacturing. This agreement covers the territories of India, Nepal, and Bhutan and was finalized today at Comansa's headquarters in Pamplona, Spain.

As part of this strategic partnership, Vertikal has committed to investing in 100 Comansa Tower Cranes for rental over the next three years. This investment will significantly enhance Vertikal’s fleet and enable it to meet the growing demand for high-quality construction equipment in the region.

In addition to this groundbreaking partnership, Vertikal is proud to announce that Al Tasneem Group of Oman has taken a stake in the company, marking a significant step towards expanding Vertikal's business operations in the Middle East region. The collaboration aims to leverage Al Tasneem Group’s expertise and network to facilitate growth and provide superior services to clients across the Middle East.

Furthermore, Vertikal has placed an initial order for five units of the Comansa 21CM335 12T Tower Crane, which will be incorporated into its fleet. These cranes are recognized for their reliability, efficiency, and advanced technology, making them an ideal choice for modern construction projects.

“This partnership with Comansa marks a significant milestone for Vertikal as we aim to expand our market presence in South Asia and the Middle East,” said Rakesh Modi, Chairperson of Mtandt. “With the support of Al Tasneem Group and our investment in Comansa’s advanced tower cranes, we are poised to deliver exceptional value and service to our customers.”

Vertikal is committed to providing innovative solutions and enhancing safety standards in the construction industry, ensuring that projects are completed efficiently and effectively.

For more information about Vertikal and its offerings, please visit.www.vertikal.in

title: Strategic Investors to Invest ₹1.5 Billion in Mtandt Rentals Limited for 20% Stake
cardTitle: Strategic Investors to Invest ₹1.5 Billion in Mtandt Rentals Limited for 20% Stake
body:
﻿Chennai, India – September 18, 2024 – Mtandt Rentals Limited, a leading player in India’s equipment rental industry, today announced that it has secured a ₹1.5 billion (approximately USD 17.5 million) investment from strategic investors, acquiring a 20% post-money stake in the company. This investment marks a significant milestone in the company’s growth and will fuel further expansion of its fleet and services.

For the financial year 2023-24, Mtandt Rentals achieved a Profit After Tax (PAT) of USD 2 million. With this latest capital infusion, the company projects a PAT of USD 4 million for FY 2024-25 and a remarkable USD 8 million for FY 2025-26.

The funds will be utilized primarily to expand the company’s fleet, with a strong focus on acquiring additional Mobile Elevating Work Platforms (MEWPs) and Access Road Mats (MATS) to meet growing demand in the construction and infrastructure sectors.

Speaking on the investment, Rakesh Modi, Chairman of Mtandt Group, said:

"The key to Mtandt Rentals' success lies in our focus. We are committed to delivering an exceptionally good customer experience, fostering an unreasonably good employee experience, and continuing to lead in the sale and rental of MEWPs and Access Road Mats. This investment will help us build on that focus and position us for even greater growth in the years to come."

Mtandt Rentals’ relentless dedication to customer satisfaction and employee well-being, combined with its sharp focus on expanding its MEWP and MATS rental services, has driven its consistent growth. With this strategic investment, the company is set to reach new heights in the coming financial years.

About Mtandt Rentals Limited

Mtandt Rentals Limited (MRL) is a part of Mtandt Group. A leader in providing solutions to their customers as they build, maintain, repair and operate Manufacturing Plants, Facilities and Infrastructure. Mtandt Rentals Limited is focused on Renting MEWP and Temporary Road Mats. MRL rents and sells Tower Cranes through its subsidiary Vertikal and Provides MEWP Operator and Service Training through its subsidiary CESL.

For more information, visit here: Mtandt Group

title: Mtandt Group Partners with CO.ME.T. Officine to Expand Product Portfolio and Reach
cardTitle: Mtandt Group Partners with CO.ME.T. Officine to Expand Product Portfolio and Reach
body:
Mtandt Group, a global leader for equipment in construction and infrastructure solutions, is thrilled to announce a strategic partnership with CO.ME.T. Officine, a renowned manufacturer of aerial work platforms (AWPs) and industrial equipment. This collaboration marks a significant milestone in Mtandt's journey towards enhancing its product offerings and expanding its market presence worldwide.
The partnership encompasses multiple facets aimed at leveraging each other's strengths and expertise to deliver superior products and services to customers globally. The key highlights of the collaboration include:

Technical Collaboration Agreement for Truck Mounted AWP Manufacturing:


Mtandt Group and CO.ME.T. Officine have signed a Technical Collaboration Agreement to manufacture Truck Mounted Aerial Work Platforms (AWPs) at Mtandt's state-of-the-art facility in Jewar, Uttar Pradesh, India. This strategic move aims to capitalize on the growing demand for high-quality AWPs in the global market while leveraging CO.ME.T. Officine's advanced technology and Mtandt's manufacturing prowess.

Exclusive Distribution Rights for CO.ME.T. Range in SAARC Region:


In addition to the manufacturing collaboration, Mtandt Group has secured exclusive distribution rights for the CO.ME.T. range of industrial equipment in the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) region. This partnership allows Mtandt to offer a comprehensive portfolio of innovative and reliable industrial solutions to customers across SAARC countries, strengthening its position as a leading provider of construction and infrastructure work-at-heights equipment solutions in the region.

Order Placement for 20 Units of CO.ME.T OFFICINE:


As a testament to the confidence in the partnership and the quality of Co.Me.T’s products, Mtandt Group has placed an initial order for 20 units of CO.ME.T. truck mounted aerial work platform, valued at 1.5 million dollars, for its rental fleet. These units will further enhance Mtandt's rental offerings, enabling customers to access cutting-edge industrial equipment for their projects while reinforcing Mtandt's commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction.
Speaking about the partnership, Rakesh Modi, Chairman of Mtandt Group, expressed his enthusiasm, stating, "We are delighted to partner with CO.ME.T. Officine, a renowned name in the industry, to strengthen our product portfolio and expand our global reach. This collaboration underscores our commitment to delivering innovative solutions and unparalleled value to our customers worldwide.

About CO.ME.T. Officine:


CO.ME.T. Officine S.P.A.that stands for Costruzione Meccaniche e Trasportatori i.e. Mechanical Construction and Transportation systems was founded in 1960 by Walter Aleotti and has been the first company to introduce in Europe the concept of “platform for aerial works”, equipment that finally enabled operators to work safely and with comfort at high altitude. It produces several types of Aerial Platforms with various working heights from 10 up to 45 meters , assembled on trucks, tractors or self propelled.
CO.ME.T. Officine provides a whole product range with the most advanced systems, to fulfil all the needs of operators for both public and private companies acting in garden maintenance, building industry, electricity, road works, etc With a rich heritage and a global presence, CO.ME.T. Officine is committed to delivering superior products and solutions to customers across industries.

title: Rakesh Modi, Chairman speaks on sustainable construction equipment
cardTitle: Rakesh Modi, Chairman speaks on sustainable construction equipment
body:
1. How important is sustainability to your company's mission and values?

Sustainability is an integral part of the Mtandt Group's mission and values. Our company is committed to creating a positive impact on the environment and society by providing sustainable products and services to our customers.

2. What types of sustainable construction equipment does your company manufacture, and how do they differ from traditional equipment?

We offer and manufacture sustainable construction equipment, including electric and hybrid-powered aerial work platforms, scaffoldings, and access equipment. These products are designed to be more energy-efficient, produce fewer emissions, and have a lower environmental impact than traditional equipment. We have introduced a range of rough terrain scissors with working height up to 32 meters and rough terrain boom lift with working height up to 44 meters in an electric-powered version instead of using Fossil Fuel.

We also have introduced an "Oil-Free" range of slab scissors and order pickers that use mechanical actuators instead of hydraulic cylinders and consume 75% less energy.


3. What specific technologies or features do you incorporate into your sustainable construction equipment (e.g. electric or hybrid power, reduced emissions, recyclable materials)?

Our sustainable construction equipment incorporates advanced technologies and features such as electric or hybrid power, regenerative braking, energy-efficient motors, and the use of recyclable and eco-friendly materials. These features not only reduce the environmental impact of our equipment but also offer significant cost savings and improved performance for our customers.

title: AQ Aluminium Scaffoldings Leading from the front!
cardTitle: AQ Aluminium Scaffoldings Leading from the front!
body:
Driving Innovations for Safety and Productivity with AQ Aluminium Scaffoldings

Mtandt Group is India’s leading Aluminium Scaffolding Manufacturing, Sales and Rental company. Our systems are engineered and customized to meet the site’s unique requirements to provide an additional layer of security for the construction workers to access work at heights with maximum safety. The sense of safety in the minds of the working crew results in enhanced efficiency and productivity to promote growth.

Our systems have been designed and engineered with safety and productivity in mind, which has led to innovations that have become the first choice of working crew across every industry from Construction, Manufacturing, Aviation, Ports, Malls, IT buns, Warehouses and more.

With more than four decades of research and development, our quest to make Aluminium Scaffolding safer and better is a reality. We are the first company in India to achieve an 80-90% weld-less Aluminium Scaffolding manufacturing process that results in Increased Strength by one and half times more than the regular welding process.

In addition, The Tensile Strength of the hard alloy is T6, which makes it the best in the industry. The double-extruded accurate concentric pipe engineering enables weldless solutions. The stainless steel anchor joints and the cold-pressed spigot-moulded process has been used for enhanced strength and durability. Our system AQ conforms to the latest EN standard 1004:2021.

Our ultimate goal is to provide the utmost safety to the working crew and enhance productivity at the worksite with our AQ Aluminium Scaffolding System. With our continuous research and development, we are able to make the systems safer, studier, more environmentally friendly and cost-effective.

title: Mtandt Group Presenting HSE Awards at OSH India 2022!
cardTitle: Mtandt Group Presenting HSE Awards at OSH India 2022!
body:
Mtandt Group presented the Health, Safety, and Environment Awards at OSH 2022, organized in Mumbai on the 24th and 25th of November. Mr Gopal Modi, Director at Mtandt, presented the awards to companies upholding the globally benchmarked standards in construction, manufacturing and other industries.
OSH India Awards by Informa Markets is one of the most coveted safety awards. It recognizes companies and individuals for their efforts in health and safety and provides them with an opportunity to be known internationally.
Mtandt Group is a pioneer in working at height solutions and has provided various industries with fall protection systems, WEB decking and netting solutions and rope access solutions to enhance safety for the workers when carrying out their tasks and increase productivity at the site.
